prompts.name: earnings_play
prompts.description: How do I trade the ticker's earnings? Implied move, expected crush, best strategy, dealer setup.

prompts.name: surface_read
prompts.description: Any vol-surface arb or rich/cheap wings on the ticker? SVI fit, arbitrage flags, surface anomalies.

prompts.name: whats_changed
prompts.description: What changed since yesterday (or a reference date) on a ticker — biggest OI shifts and net exposure moves.

prompts.name: dealer_positioning_deep
prompts.description: Deep drill into dealer gamma by strike and DTE — per-strike walls, DAG, term structure.

prompts.name: pin_risk_check
prompts.description: Will the ticker pin at a specific strike today? Magnet strike, pin score, and probability.

prompts.name: screen_watchlist
prompts.description: Of a list of names, which has richest premium, strongest pin, or unusual flow? Ranked shortlist.

prompts.name: flow_direction
prompts.description: Are big players bullish or bearish on the ticker? Net flow, opening vs closing premium.

prompts.name: income_overlay
prompts.description: Best covered call or cash-secured put to write — strike, expiry, income tradeoffs.

prompts.name: premium_selling_check
prompts.description: Is now a good time to sell premium? VRP richness, gamma regime support, carry structure, warnings.

prompts.name: vrp_regime_check
prompts.description: Pull the VRP dashboard for a ticker and judge whether implied vol is rich vs realized, with strategy implications.

prompts.name: daily_brief
prompts.description: One-screen daily brief for a ticker — price, regime, key levels, macro tone.

prompts.name: dealer_regime_play
prompts.description: How to trade the current gamma regime — regime classification, dealer risk profile, and the strategy playbook.

prompts.name: size_the_trade
prompts.description: How big should I size this options trade? Kelly-implied size and risk in greeks terms.

prompts.name: directional_setup
prompts.description: Is the directional path open for a call or put? Dealer walls, expected move, IV check.

prompts.name: tail_hedge_check
prompts.description: Is downside protection cheap on the ticker? Tail richness, put/put-spread cost vs historical.

prompts.name: zero_dte_live
prompts.description: Live, intraday 0DTE read on a ticker (not stale settled OI). Fetches the live snapshot, intraday series, and dealer hedge-flow then synthesises the current 0DTE regime.

prompts.name: skew_read
prompts.description: What is skew telling you — put/call skew, 25-delta risk reversal, positioning/fear implications.

prompts.name: dispersion_check
prompts.description: Is index vol cheap vs single names? Implied correlation, dispersion-trade signal.

prompts.name: market_regime
prompts.description: What regime is the market in? Risk-on/off, vol term structure, correlation backdrop.

prompts.name: earnings_screen
prompts.description: Which names have rich earnings vol this week? Top names by earnings VRP with dates.
